items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Wilfred is your correct name. I've been called Bill ever since I was born, I guess.

ctx.x: Okay, we'll do a little talking now. Let me see, I better put the place where we're recording. This is recorded at the Howard Tilton Library, Tulane University, and it's an interview with Bill Bourgeois, and today is December the 10th of 19... Okay, 1959. So we're gonna get your name on here first. All right. What is it? You mean my correct name? Well, you can give it if you want to.
It doesn't matter. Wilfred. Wilfred is your correct name. I've been called Bill ever since I was born, I guess.

Bill Bourgeois. And Florence, what's your name? You're taking pictures here. Florence, Florence. And I'm Dick Allen. Okay, let's see. We were just playing that Bosdell for a record of... Let's see, what was that? Waffle Man's Call? Waffle Man's Call. That's pretty old, isn't it? Yeah, 24, I think. And you said... That's about the year I started playing. Yeah, is that right? And you were saying he was good with the plunging music, huh?
